title: 日本ダービーの後に・矛盾する気持ち

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon lives up to her fans' expectations and finishes the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though she finishes in first place, her dream of winning the Triple Crown is over. Despite that, Mihono Bourbon feels the strong urge to run in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower seems not to care about winning or losing—she just wants to "catch up." Mihono Bourbon is very confused by this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I reassure her that she'll understand someday. In the meantime, we establish the final Classic Triple Crown race, the Kikuka Sho, as her next goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though her dream of winning the Triple Crown is already over, Mihono Bourbon feels the inexplicable urge to stay the course and run the Kikuka Sho.
